startApp(packagename, wait = True)
    start an application / applications
    packagename (Single String or List of String)
    wait (Boolean Optional) wait for the started application(s) operation end

Example of startApp :
from androidhelper import Android
droid = Android()
droid.startApp('com.tencent.mm') #only one packagename
droid.startApp(['com.tencent.mm','com.tencent.mobileqq'], False) #multi packagenames, do not wait started applications operation end
